knowledge:
- key_parameters: parentDir=Directory containing quantification subfolders ;; isoformExonAnnoation=Path to GTF/GFF file for transcript structures ;; isoformNtFasta=Path to fasta file containing transcript nucleotide sequences ;; outputSequences=Set to TRUE to write fasta files for external tools ;; prepareForWebServers=Set to TRUE to format fasta files for webserver limits ;; pathToCPC2resultFile=Path to CPC2 output file ;; pathToPFAMresultFile=Path to Pfam output file ;; pathToSignalPresultFile=Path to SignalP output file ;; pathToIUPred2AresultFile=Path to IUPred2A output file ;; filterForConsequences=Set to TRUE to filter for switches with predicted functional consequences
- alternatives: isoformSwitchTestDEXSeq()=Recommended default for testing isoform switches ;; isoformSwitchTestSatuRn()=Alternative switch test scalable for bulk and single-cell RNA-seq ;; analyzeCPAT() vs analyzeCPC2()=Alternative tools for coding potential assessment ;; analyzeIUPred2A() vs analyzeNetSurfP3()=Alternative tools for predicting intrinsically disordered regions
- when_to_use: When analyzing RNA-seq data (short-read, long-read, or single-cell) with isoform-level resolution to identify and visualize isoform switches and their predicted functional consequences across different conditions.
- pitfalls: Requires independent biological replicates (at least three are highly recommended; statistical performance and FDR control are poor with only two) ;; Quantification, GTF file, and fasta file must all contain information on the exact same isoforms (matching IDs) ;; Failing to account for batch effects or confounding factors in the design matrix ;; Using outputSequences = FALSE during real runs, which prevents generating the fasta files needed for external tools

workflows.name: high_level_two_part_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform a complete isoform switch analysis using high-level wrapper functions to import, test, extract sequences, integrate external annotations, and predict consequences.
workflows.stages: 1. Import isoform expression data ;; 2. Create a design matrix ;; 3. Build the switchAnalyzeRlist ;; 4. Run Part 1 analysis (filtering, testing, ORF annotation, sequence extraction) ;; 5. Run Part 2 analysis (importing external results, splicing analysis, consequence prediction) ;; 6. Extract top switching genes
workflows.code:
salmonQuant <- importIsoformExpression(
    parentDir = system.file("extdata/",package="IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR")
)
myDesign <- data.frame(
    sampleID = colnames(salmonQuant$abundance)[-1],
    condition = gsub('_.*', '', colnames(salmonQuant$abundance)[-1])
)
aSwitchList <- importRdata(
    isoformCountMatrix   = salmonQuant$counts,
    isoformRepExpression = salmonQuant$abundance,
    designMatrix         = myDesign,
    isoformExonAnnoation = system.file("extdata/example.gtf.gz"             , package="IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR"),
    isoformNtFasta       = system.file("extdata/example_isoform_nt.fasta.gz", package="IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR"),
    fixStringTieAnnotationProblem = TRUE,
    showProgress = FALSE
)
data("exampleSwitchList")
exampleSwitchList <- subsetSwitchAnalyzeRlist(
    switchAnalyzeRlist = exampleSwitchList,
    subset = abs(exampleSwitchList$isoformFeatures$dIF) > 0.1
)
exampleSwitchList <- isoformSwitchAnalysisPart1(
    switchAnalyzeRlist   = exampleSwitchList,
    outputSequences      = FALSE, 
    prepareForWebServers = FALSE  
)
extractSwitchSummary( exampleSwitchList )
exampleSwitchList <- isoformSwitchAnalysisPart2(
  switchAnalyzeRlist        = exampleSwitchList, 
  n                         = 10,    
  removeNoncodinORFs        = TRUE,
  pathToCPC2resultFile      = system.file("extdata/cpc2_result.txt"         , package = "IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR"),
  pathToPFAMresultFile      = system.file("extdata/pfam_results.txt"        , package = "IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR"),
  pathToIUPred2AresultFile  = system.file("extdata/iupred2a_result.txt.gz"  , package = "IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR"),
  pathToSignalPresultFile   = system.file("extdata/signalP_results.txt"     , package = "IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR"),
  outputPlots               = FALSE  
)
extractTopSwitches(exampleSwitchList, filterForConsequences = TRUE, n=3)

workflows.name: detailed_custom_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform a highly customized, step-by-step isoform switch analysis using individual functions for filtering, testing, sequence extraction, and specific external annotation integrations.
workflows.stages: 1. Import isoform expression data ;; 2. Create a design matrix ;; 3. Build the switchAnalyzeRlist ;; 4. Filter out lowly expressed features ;; 5. Test for differential transcript usage ;; 6. Extract nucleotide and amino acid sequences ;; 7. Import external sequence analysis results ;; 8. Analyze alternative splicing ;; 9. Predict functional consequences
workflows.code:
salmonQuant <- importIsoformExpression(
    parentDir = system.file("extdata/", package="IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR"),
    addIsofomIdAsColumn = TRUE
)
myDesign <- data.frame(
    sampleID = colnames(salmonQuant$abundance)[-1],
    condition = gsub('_.*', '', colnames(salmonQuant$abundance)[-1])
)
aSwitchList <- importRdata(
    isoformCountMatrix   = salmonQuant$counts,
    isoformRepExpression = salmonQuant$abundance,
    designMatrix         = myDesign,
    isoformExonAnnoation = system.file("extdata/example.gtf.gz"             , package="IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR"),
    isoformNtFasta       = system.file("extdata/example_isoform_nt.fasta.gz", package="IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR"),
    showProgress = FALSE
)
data("exampleSwitchList")
exampleSwitchListFiltered <- preFilter(
    switchAnalyzeRlist = exampleSwitchList,
    isoCount = 10,
    min.Count.prop = 0.7,
    IFcutoff = 0.1,
    min.IF.prop = 0.5,
    removeSingleIsoformGenes = TRUE
)
exampleSwitchListAnalyzed <- isoformSwitchTestDEXSeq(
    switchAnalyzeRlist = exampleSwitchList,
    reduceToSwitchingGenes=TRUE
)
exampleSwitchListAnalyzed <- extractSequence(
    exampleSwitchListAnalyzed, 
    pathToOutput = '<insert_path>',
    writeToFile=FALSE 
)
data("exampleSwitchListIntermediary")
exampleSwitchListAnalyzed <- analyzeCPAT(
    switchAnalyzeRlist   = exampleSwitchListIntermediary,
    pathToCPATresultFile = system.file("extdata/cpat_results.txt", package = "IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR"),
    codingCutoff         = 0.725, 
    removeNoncodinORFs   = TRUE   
)
exampleSwitchListAnalyzed <- analyzeCPC2(
    switchAnalyzeRlist   = exampleSwitchListAnalyzed,
    pathToCPC2resultFile = system.file("extdata/cpc2_result.txt", package = "IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR"),
    removeNoncodinORFs   = TRUE   
)
exampleSwitchListAnalyzed <- analyzePFAM(
    switchAnalyzeRlist   = exampleSwitchListAnalyzed,
    pathToPFAMresultFile = system.file("extdata/pfam_results.txt", package = "IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR"),
    showProgress=FALSE
)
exampleSwitchListAnalyzed <- analyzeSignalP(
    switchAnalyzeRlist       = exampleSwitchListAnalyzed,
    pathToSignalPresultFile  = system.file("extdata/signalP_results.txt", package = "IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR")
)
exampleSwitchListAnalyzed <- analyzeIUPred2A(
    switchAnalyzeRlist        = exampleSwitchListAnalyzed,
    pathToIUPred2AresultFile = system.file("extdata/iupred2a_result.txt.gz", package = "IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR"),
    showProgress = FALSE
)
exampleSwitchListAnalyzed <- analyzeNetSurfP3(
    switchAnalyzeRlist = exampleSwitchListAnalyzed,
    pathToNetSurfP3resultFile = system.file("extdata/netsurfp3_result.csv.gz", package = "IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR"),
    showProgress = FALSE
)
exampleSwitchListAnalyzed <- analyzeDeepLoc2(
    switchAnalyzeRlist = exampleSwitchListAnalyzed,
    pathToDeepLoc2resultFile = system.file("extdata/deeploc2.csv", package = "IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR"),
    quiet = FALSE
)
exampleSwitchListAnalyzed <- analyzeDeepTMHMM(
    switchAnalyzeRlist   = exampleSwitchListAnalyzed,
    pathToDeepTMHMMresultFile = system.file("extdata/DeepTMHMM.gff3", package = "IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR"),
    showProgress=FALSE
)
exampleSwitchListAnalyzed <- analyzeAlternativeSplicing(
    switchAnalyzeRlist = exampleSwitchListAnalyzed,
    quiet=TRUE
)
consequencesOfInterest <- c('intron_retention','coding_potential','NMD_status','domains_identified','ORF_seq_similarity')
exampleSwitchListAnalyzed <- analyzeSwitchConsequences(
    exampleSwitchListAnalyzed,
    consequencesToAnalyze = consequencesOfInterest, 
    dIFcutoff = 0.4, 
    showProgress=FALSE
)
